title: Facebook and Instagram Ads for Pet Businesses | Software Pro Digital

facts.fact: Software Pro Digital says it refreshes pet-business ad creative with three to five new concepts a month for a local service and more for a brand.
facts.quote: Three to five new concepts a month for a local service, more for a brand, because creative fatigue is the real ceiling.

facts.fact: Software Pro Digital says it reports Meta ad results on bookings and orders rather than on reach.
facts.quote: We report on bookings and orders rather than on reach.
